features.justification_quote: If you don't separate these, your eval rewards models for confidently flailing on impossible tasks and penalizes appropriate giving-up.
Spirals are usually detectable well before then; long caps mostly burn tokens.

features.quote: Early-stop instrumentation: detect repetition online and terminate the run once spiral is confirmed for N consecutive turns.
features.justification_quote: Saves the tail of every spiraling run, which is the most expensive part.
